meaning: 捡越多垃圾，得到越多钱
usageNote: 经典'the more...the more'句型！表示两件事同步增长，超实用的比较句式～

examples.en: The more trash I collect, the more money they give me at the recycling center.
examples.zh: 我在回收站收集的垃圾越多，他们给我的钱就越多。

examples.en: The more trash I collect, the more money they give — so I walk every street in the neighborhood!
examples.zh: 我捡的垃圾越多他们给的钱越多，所以我把每条街都走遍了！
